label_process: Independent development-agent source-section labeling for this new expanded manifest before its candidate evaluation. No ranker or evaluator was invoked during this labeling task. This is a developer-authored diagnostic, not a blinded human or held-out evaluation.
prior_exposure_disclosure: The labeling agent previously curated source records, implemented UI/provenance tests and observed exploratory prototype queries. These 64 labels were derived from the frozen source contents and limitations rather than new candidate outputs; prior development exposure prevents a blind-holdout claim.

relevance_definition: Binary section relevance means substantive direct support for a requested component or identified historical/background assistance. It does not mean complete support; expected_answerable=false can coexist with relevant background. Mere shared topic words alone are insufficient.
required_document_ids_definition: For answerable cases, the minimum labeled source components needed together; corroborating relevant sources can be optional. The existing ranker runner uses any relevant section for some metrics and does not by itself establish joint completeness.
limitations: Developer-authored, independently agent-labeled diagnostic; not blinded human labeling, a held-out set, or an independent institutional evaluation.
The author had prior source-curation and exploratory prototype-query exposure; no candidate runs occurred during authoring this new manifest.
Balanced 32 English and 32 Chinese cases are deliberately source-covered concepts and misses, not sampled production prevalence.
Relevance labels may identify partial or historical background for an unanswerable request; current-law, calibration and firm-specific gaps remain separately unanswerable.
All regulatory records lack verified current-consolidated status. Future records are scoped relative to the fixed labeling date, 2026-10-25.
No labels certify legal correctness, full statutory capital implementation, citation entailment or production security.
Compound positive cases need all required source components; existing any-relevant-section answer metrics cannot establish complete compound-answer support.
Each negative compound requires abstention from a complete conclusion, though authorized partial evidence may be displayed with explicit missing-scope limitations.
Only frozen source text/metadata and role/lifecycle constraints informed labels; the original 44-case manifest was not changed.
After candidate inspection, preserve this snapshot. Corrections or additional cases require a separately versioned manifest with a disclosed rationale, not silent relabeling.
